resolved_flags.reading: Both plural-ending ā vowels have nasal tildes; preceding e has breve, not macron.
jī-kăde confirmed macron, separate ordinary j dot. Initial suspicion of short i rejected by narrow original crop.
khēndēn confirmed two macrons; final n is plain, no nasal vowel mark inserted.
naukărĕ confirmed: final e breve, r plain. Initial underdot suspicion rejected by narrow original crop; no correction.
ṭākke confirmed initial underdot in narrow original crop.
ŭjāṛĕa: r underdot, e breve, final a plain, source-confirmed.
gea final a plain, distinct from later same-line geā. Original Rect(20,438,160,479) at9x.
